title: Part 10
content_zh: Shennong, the Divine Farmer, taught humanity to plant the five grains. Before him, people hunted and gathered, living at the mercy of the seasons. He tasted a hundred herbs, finding which healed and which poisoned.
content_en: Shennong, the Divine Farmer, taught humanity to plant the five grains. Before him, people hunted and gathered, living at the mercy of the seasons. He tasted a hundred herbs, finding which healed and which poisoned.
